package cache

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"

	"example.test/auth"
	"example.test/httperr"
)

func checkedFigure(ctx context.Context, key string) (int, error) {
	if err := auth.Require(ctx); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return len(key), nil
}

func uncheckedFigure(key string) int { return len(key) }

// heldCache is filled only after a checked read.
type heldCache struct{ cache map[string]int }

func (c *heldCache) read(ctx context.Context, key string) (int, error) {
	if figure, ok := c.cache[key]; ok {
		return figure, nil
	}
	figure, err := checkedFigure(ctx, key)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	c.cache[key] = figure
	return figure, nil
}

// leakyCache reads like heldCache, but prime fills it unchecked.
type leakyCache struct{ cache map[string]int }

func (c *leakyCache) read(ctx context.Context, key string) (int, error) {
	if figure, ok := c.cache[key]; ok {
		return figure, nil
	}
	figure, err := checkedFigure(ctx, key)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	c.cache[key] = figure
	return figure, nil
}

func (c *leakyCache) prime(key string) { c.cache[key] = uncheckedFigure(key) }

type Handlers struct {
	held  *heldCache
	leaky *leakyCache
}

func New() Handlers {
	return Handlers{held: &heldCache{cache: map[string]int{}}, leaky: &leakyCache{cache: map[string]int{}}}
}

func serve(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, figure int, err error) {
	if err != nil {
		httperr.Write(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, figure)
}

func (h Handlers) GetThroughAHeldCache(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	figure, err := h.held.read(r.Context(), r.URL.Path)
	serve(w, r, figure, err)
}

func (h Handlers) GetThroughALeakyCache(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	figure, err := h.leaky.read(r.Context(), r.URL.Path)
	serve(w, r, figure, err)
}

// A read with no ok cannot tell a hit from a miss.
func (h Handlers) GetThroughAPlainRead(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, h.held.cache[r.URL.Path])
}

// On the miss branch the cache holds nothing that was checked.
func (h Handlers) GetOnTheMissBranch(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	figure, ok := h.held.cache[r.URL.Path]
	if !ok {
		httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, figure)
		return
	}
	httperr.Write(w, r, auth.OffError{})
}
